item.title: Exploring social network analysis for understanding terrorism 🦹
item.author: nguyenmanhhung04051998@gmail.com (Nguyen Manh Hung)
item.description:
What is social network analysis and how can it be applied to help us understand the structure and dynamics of terrorist networks? We’ll demystify the basics of centrality, community and show you how it can reveal the inner workings of terrorist groups.

You can access an interactive Streamlit dashboard here: Link

Terrorist and random network analysis

This project examines terrorist social networks using data available from data information sources in Valdis Krebs’ article. Specifically, we examine the network surrounding the tragic events of September 11, 2001. The September 11, 2001 attacks were four Islamist suicide attacks carried out on the same day in the United States. With the dataset, we are able to map a part of the network centered around the 19 deceased hijackers. This network gives us an insight into the terrorist organization.
